winf = 1000000000

class Road:
    def __init__(self, nxt=0, to=0, f=0, w=0):
        self.nxt = nxt
        self.to = to
        self.f = f
        self.w = w

r = [Road() for _ in range(M << 1)]
head = [0] * N
cnt = 1

    global cnt

    head[u] = cnt
    cnt += 1
    r[cnt] = Road(head[v], u, 0, -w)
    head[v] = cnt

class MinCostFlow:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.size = size
        self.cur = [0] * (size + 1)
        self.vis = [False] * (size + 1)
        self.dis = [0] * (size + 1)
        self.tag = [0] * (size + 1)
        self.q = []

    class Node:
        def __init__(self, u=0, v=0):
            self.u = u
            self.v = v
        def __lt__(self, other):
            return self.v > other.v

    def dij(self, s, t):
        for i in range(1, self.size + 1):
            self.dis[i] = winf
            self.cur[i] = head[i]
        self.dis[t] = 0
        self.q = []
        heapq.heappush(self.q, self.Node(t, 0))
        while self.q:
            u = heapq.heappop(self.q).u
            if self.vis[u]:
                continue
            self.vis[u] = True
            i = head[u]
            while i:
                v = r[i].to
                w_ = self.tag[u] + r[i ^ 1].w - self.tag[v]
                if r[i ^ 1].f and self.dis[u] + w_ < self.dis[v]:
                    self.dis[v] = self.dis[u] + w_
                    heapq.heappush(self.q, self.Node(v, self.dis[v]))
                i = r[i].nxt
        for i in range(1, self.size + 1):
            self.tag[i] = min(self.tag[i] + self.dis[i], winf)
        if not self.vis[s]:
            return False
        for i in range(1, self.size + 1):
            self.vis[i] = False
        return True

    def dfs(self, u, t, fl):
        if u == t or not fl:
            return fl
        res = 0
        self.vis[u] = True
        i = self.cur[u]
        while i:
            if r[i].f:
                v = r[i].to
                f_ = 0
                if not self.vis[v] and self.tag[v] + r[i].w == self.tag[u] and (f_ := self.dfs(v, t, min(fl, r[i].f))):
                    r[i].f -= f_
                    r[i ^ 1].f += f_
                    res += f_
                    fl -= f_
                    if not fl:
                        break
            i = r[i].nxt
        self.vis[u] = False
        return res

    def work(self, s, t):
        nonlocal maxf, minw
        while self.dij(s, t):
            w = self.dfs(s, t, inf)
            maxf += w
            minw += w * self.tag[s]
